items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: No, I don't. Oh, all I knew was Mrs. Mosby.

ctx.x: -- you mentioned that Curtis Mosby's wife ran one of the Clubs on Central Avenue in Los Angeles. Do you remember what her name was?
No, I don't. Oh, all I knew was Mrs. Mosby.
Was she an entertainer at all?
